meaning: OPTIO2 bonus-interval DIP-field mask: 0x70 = bits 4-6. CHEKBO (W3MAIN.MAC:5621) does AND OPTIO2,BONMSK / CMP I,BONMSK / IFNE (a fully-set field disables the bonus) then LSR x3 to turn the masked byte into the .WORD offset into BONINL. Hex 70 under the inherited .RADIX 16.

Bonus-city score interval (index 0, the shipped default DIP = OPTIO2 bits clear). BONINL is a .WORD table read AS BCD under CHEKBO's SED divide; entry 0 = hex word 0100 = BCD 100. CHEKBO divides LSCORM:LSCORH (score/100), so the interval in points is 100 x 100 = 10,000 — the factory 'bonus city every 10,000' setting. DERIVED (BCD x 100); consistency-checked in citations-source.test.ts.

Bonus-city score interval (index 1). BONINL entry 1 = hex word 0120 = BCD 120; x 100 (score/100 via LSCORM:LSCORH) = 12,000 points. DERIVED (BCD x 100); consistency-checked in citations-source.test.ts.
